decisions.statement: A check's page names the export the check runs.
The checks are found in the index.
A model check is gathered here beside the code checks.
A count of runs above zero is the phase a model check runs on.
A check whose page states `experimental` is gathered on no phase.
Such a check carries the phases its page states beside the phases it judges on.
A check whose page states no `experimental` judges on the phases that page states.
Finding the checks costs nothing the pages grow.
An index naming no check refuses the change the index would leave unjudged.
A check is run once over the change the check was given rather than over the pages.
A check no changed path is input to does not run where no root was handed in.
A run handed a root runs the audit of every check gathered with one.
Such a run is handed a change naming no path, and asks for no listing of its own.
A change no check takes as input is refused rather than judged clean.
A run handed a root makes no such refusal, one check taking nothing being a clean verdict.
A check the change takes away runs over no part of that change.
A check is taken away where the change takes away the check's page or the code beside that page.
A change taking away every check is refused.
A check's code is loaded from the tree rather than from the change.
A check whose own code file is there is loaded from that file.
A check with no code file of its own is loaded from the code its module page names.
The file a check was loaded from is the file taking that check away.
A check whose audit code file is there is gathered with that audit.
A check with no audit code file is gathered with no audit rather than refused.
A check whose audit file answers to nothing that can be run is gathered as a check that refuses.
A run handed a root runs each check's audit over that root.
A check with no audit judges nothing where a root was handed in.
A run handed no root runs every check over the change.
A run over a subset of the files is a run over a change rather than an audit.
A check stating no input runs for every change.
A check whose input could not be answered runs.
One shadow is cast over the change here and handed to every check.
One run id is minted for each change judged.
Every check judged over one change has one run id.
A check that ran is named on a list the caller hands in.
A caller wanting none of that naming hands in no list.
A run id is a uuid version 7.
The files and index a change leaves are worked out before any check runs.
No check is charged the working out every check at that landing reads.
A shadow that could not be worked out refuses the change before any check runs.
Why a check page or its code would not load is carried into the refusal.
A check that could not be gathered refuses rather than stopping the gather.
A check that could not be gathered refuses on every phase.
The checks beside a check that could not be gathered are gathered and judge.
A check that could not be gathered is marked as a check that could not run.
A check that threw refuses the change the check could not judge.
That refusal is marked as a check that could not run.
The refusal names the check's own page.
The refusal names the file and line the fault was thrown at.
The file and line are said before the fault's message.
A frame the fault was called from is named after the fault's message.
A frame repeating the file the frame before named is said by line and column alone.
The frames end where the fault reaches the runner here.
A check spending more processor time than its group states refuses the change.
The check runs to its end before that refusal.
The time counted is the check's own processor time together with the time the check spawns.
Which group's code ran decides which of the groups states the ceiling.
A run narrowed to named files runs the check group's code.
A group stating no ceiling refuses nothing however long its check runs.
The memory ceiling an audit group states is gathered beside its time ceiling.
Nothing here holds a check to the memory ceiling gathered.
One check is gathered by its slug alone, the other checks being left unloaded.
A slug no check page and no model check carries is gathered as no check.
Nothing here stops a check part way through for spending too long.
A run's cost is recorded under the logs of the group whose code ran.
A check with no code is recorded under `entries`.
A run handed a root records the verdict it took on the row recording its cost.
A run handed no root records what it cost and no verdict.
The verdict recorded holds every refusal the run answers with.
A path the change takes away is handed to every check.
A path the change takes away reads there as a path whose body is nothing.
Audit is the same run over every path the index files including page and property files alike.
A path is taken from the index rather than worked out here from the property names above a file.
A path is read out of the change by name as well as in turn.
A check needing a path the check was not handed reads the change's body rather than the disk's.
A check the change adds does not judge that change.
A check page with no code beside that page and no phase stated is gathered as no check.
A check page stating a phase with no code beside that page is gathered as a check that refuses.

definition: every check gathered and run over one change, answering what refuses it
